# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 77 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 49 | Coptic

---

## Saying 77

Jesus said: "I am the light over everything. I am the Everything. All things came from me, and all things reached me. Split open a log of wood — I am there. Pick up a stone — you will find me underneath it."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "The Everything" — renders *ptērf* in plain English while preserving the cosmic scope
- "Reached me" — *attain* rendered as arrival; the all finding its destination
- "Split open a log" — more vivid and physical than "piece of wood"
- "Underneath it" — the stone is lifted and what is beneath is revealed: presence hidden in matter
- This is one of the most cited sayings in discussions of Thomas's mysticism and divine immanence
